How do I upgrade Laravel safely?
output: 1. Read upgrade guide (breaking + deprecations) for YOUR jump (Shift automates mechanical parts). 2. Update PHP first (Laravel needs current PHP). 3. `composer update` in a branch; fix deprecations (run with error reporting loud). 4. Run full test suite (feature + unit) — green before proceeding. 5. Deploy like normal release (migrations backward-compatible!). Never skip majors; Shift PRs are human-reviewed, never blind-merged.
